subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

Why was such a letter written by your brother?

options.text: Why was your brother writing such a letter?
Why had your brother written such a letter?
Why did your brother write such a letter?
Why does your brother write such a letter?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure for questions: Wh-word + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb + object.
 
• The original interrogative sentence is in the **Simple Past** passive form: *"was... written"*.
 
• To convert an interrogative sentence from passive to active voice: Identify the agent "your brother" and make it the subject of the active sentence.
 
• Change the passive verb phrase "was written" to the active simple past form. In a question, the simple past uses the auxiliary verb "did" followed by the base form of the verb "write".
 
• Move the passive subject "such a letter" to the object position.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why did your brother write such a letter?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Why was your brother writing..." – Incorrect tense (Past Continuous instead of Simple Past).
 
• **Option 2: **"Why had your brother written..." – Incorrect tense (Past Perfect instead of Simple Past).
 
• **Option 4: **"Why does your brother write..." – Incorrect tense (Simple Present instead of Simple Past).
